nodes.name: 罗马
nodes.title: 军团集结
nodes.history: 共和国的政治中心，本局军团由此出发。
nodes.history_en: The political center of the Republic and the starting point of this campaign.

nodes.name: 马西利亚
nodes.title: 港口补给
nodes.history: 希腊殖民者建立的港城，前30年已处于罗马势力范围。
nodes.history_en: Founded by Greek settlers, this port was already within the Roman sphere by 30 BC.

nodes.name: 塔拉科
nodes.title: 沿岸关隘
nodes.history: 罗马在伊比利亚的重要据点，位于今塔拉戈纳。
nodes.history_en: An important Roman base in Iberia, located at modern Tarragona.

nodes.name: 新迦太基
nodes.title: 港城攻坚
nodes.history: 前30年已是罗马城市，并非仍存在的迦太基国家。
nodes.history_en: By 30 BC this was a Roman city, not a surviving Carthaginian state.

nodes.name: 加德斯
nodes.title: 西线决战
nodes.history: 伊比利亚西南的古港城。西线目标属于架空战役。
nodes.history_en: An ancient port in southwestern Iberia. The western objective is fictional.

nodes.name: 迦太基
nodes.title: 旧城的记忆
nodes.history: 布匿迦太基于前146年被毁，罗马后来重建此地；前30年的此处并非独立布匿国家。
nodes.history_en: Punic Carthage was destroyed in 146 BC and later rebuilt by Rome. In 30 BC it was not an independent Punic state.

nodes.name: 叙拉古
nodes.title: 西西里整备
nodes.history: 西西里的希腊古城，此时已纳入罗马统治。
nodes.history_en: An ancient Greek city in Sicily, already under Roman rule at this time.

nodes.name: 昔兰尼
nodes.title: 北非决战
nodes.history: 北非的希腊古城，前30年已在罗马统治下。
nodes.history_en: An ancient Greek city in North Africa, under Roman rule by 30 BC.

nodes.name: 布伦迪西乌姆
nodes.title: 东航准备
nodes.history: 意大利东南的港口，也是阿庇亚大道的终点。
nodes.history_en: A port in southeastern Italy and the terminus of the Appian Way.

nodes.name: 雅典
nodes.title: 城邦议事
nodes.history: 使用古名 Athenae，此时并非与罗马争霸的独立大国。
nodes.history_en: Known in antiquity as Athenae; at this time it was not an independent great power competing with Rome.

nodes.name: 罗得
nodes.title: 航道争夺
nodes.history: 爱琴海东南的港城；本局遭遇不代表史实上的敌我关系。
nodes.history_en: A port in the southeastern Aegean. This encounter does not represent historical alliances or hostilities.

nodes.name: 安条克
nodes.title: 东线决战
nodes.history: 叙利亚的古代大城。这里使用当时的古名 Antiochia。
nodes.history_en: A major ancient city in Syria, known at the time as Antiochia.

nodes.name: 亚历山大里亚
nodes.title: 内海终章
nodes.history: 埃及在前30年并入罗马。此图采用这一时代的地点，远征顺序为游戏架空。
nodes.history_en: Egypt was annexed by Rome in 30 BC. The map uses places from that era, but the campaign route is fictional.
